name: Cursor

surfaces.name: Cursor agent (editor and CLI): skill folder

notes: Only ~/.cursor/skills syncs to Cursor cloud agents (Settings > Agents > Sync Skills for Cloud Agents). Cloud agents are a hosted sandbox.
prerequisites: Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine

docs.title: Agent Skills (Cursor)
docs.facts: Loads .agents/skills, .cursor/skills, ~/.agents/skills and ~/.cursor/skills, and for compatibility .claude/skills, .codex/skills, ~/.claude/skills and ~/.codex/skills. Nested project folders are scoped. Only ~/.cursor/skills syncs to cloud agents.

install.evidence: the installer tests (Linux) put the skill, stamp and all files in the folder this host's documentation names; the host itself was not run; docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#cursor
